The '''Sith armada''', also known as the '''Sith battle fleet''' or simply the '''Sith fleet''', was the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].

==History==
Following the end of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] in [[3960 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] led about a third of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], supposedly under the pretense of tracking any surviving [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. However, the Jedi encountered the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and were corrupted by him. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] persuaded the pair to return to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] with their [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and located the legendary [[Star Forge]], an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].

In [[3959 BBY]], Revan and Malak returned to the Republic, using their fleet to instigate the [[Jedi Civil War]]. They located the Star Forge and used the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] to add many new [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to their navy.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Later, in [[3956 BBY]], the navy&mdash;under command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Varko (Human)|Varko]]&mdash;took part in the [[Battle of Rakata Prime]]. A Republic fleet, led by a team of Jedi, attacked the Star Forge. During the battle, the Sith armada was bolstered by the Star Forge's defenses and starship manufacturing capabilities. However, as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Malak was slain aboard the [[Space station/Legends|station]] in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], the Republic fleet destroyed the station, and decimated the remaining Sith fleet.<ref name="KOTOR" />
